styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Venetian walls, the Green Line and old mosques and churches.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Leventis, Byzantine art and the car-free old lanes.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Halloumi, meze and strong coffee in the old town.

stays.why: Restored pedestrian lanes inside the walls; walk to Ledra Street and the main sights.
Cheapest base for history and food; quiet at night, a short walk to the sights.
Central and lively, with cafés and shops; easy crossing point to the north.
Quieter and cheaper; good for the bazaar and Büyük Han. Bring your passport for the crossing.

food: Try halloumi, sheftalia sausages and a meze spread; portions are large, so share.
Old town cafés serve strong Cypriot coffee; ask for it 'sketo' (no sugar) or 'metrio' (medium).
The north side has cheaper kebabs and sweets around the bazaar; check prices first.
Lunch is the main meal; many places close mid-afternoon, so eat early.
A sit-down meze for two costs roughly EUR 30–50; a cheap souvlaki lunch about EUR 6–10.
more_time: Hire a car for a day trip to the Troodos mountains or the Kyrenia range; check the border rules first.
Add a half-day to the Archaeological Museum and the Byzantine Museum for deeper history.
Swap an afternoon for a walk along the Green Line and the buffer-zone viewpoints.

recommend.why: One night covers the walled old city on foot; add a night for museums and the north side.

month_notes: January: cool and wet, highs near 15°C. Pack a jacket and an umbrella.
February: still cool, fewer rain days. Good for walking the old town.
March: mild and pleasant, around 20°C. A good month to visit.
April: warm and dry, highs near 25°C. Ideal for sightseeing on foot.
May: hot by afternoon, around 30°C. Sightsee early and rest at midday.
June: hot, highs near 34°C. Carry water and use shade.
July: very hot, up to 38°C. Plan indoor sights and evenings outside.
August: as hot as July, around 37°C. Avoid midday sun.
September: still hot, around 34°C, but cooling at night.
October: warm and comfortable, near 29°C. A strong month to visit.
November: mild, around 23°C, with some rain. Bring a light layer.
December: cool and wetter, highs near 18°C. Pack warm clothes.

climate_guide.summary: Mediterranean climate: mild, wet winters and very hot, dry summers. Spring and autumn are best.

items.title: Best time: March to May and October to November
items.text: Mild days around 20–29°C, good for walking the old city.

items.title: Summer is very hot (June to September)
items.text: Highs of 34–38°C. Sightsee early morning and evening; stay indoors at midday.

items.title: Wettest in winter
items.text: December to February has the most rain days (7–9 a month). Showers are usually short.

items.title: Cool winter nights
items.text: Lows around 7–9°C from December to February. Bring a warm jacket.

items.title: Sunny most of the year
items.text: Rain days drop to 1–4 from June to September. Sunscreen all year.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light clothes and a hat for summer; a jacket and umbrella for winter; comfortable shoes for cobbled lanes.

transit.best: Walk the old city; use taxis or ride apps for anything further.

modes.text: No metro or tram. The Old City is best on foot.
Buses are cheap but timetables are unreliable and few are air conditioned.
Taxis are diesel Mercedes with 'T' plates; check the meter is on. Bolt and Uber operate in the south; coverage varies.
Car hire is affordable and useful for day trips beyond the city.
The walled Old City is compact and best explored on foot.
Bike in Action needs a smart card. Ferries leave from Limassol and Larnaca, not Nicosia.
